businesses.business: polymer and metal products manufacturing and tire service distribution

offering_description.value: Manufactures engineered polymer products such as plastic reusable containers, fuel tanks, and material handling products for industrial, food, and consumer markets. Also distributes tire service tools, equipment and supplies to tire dealers and vehicle service shops. Makes products in North American plants and sells through direct and distributor channels.

primary_products.value: reusable plastic containers and pallets; fuel tanks and storage containers; tire repair and retreading supplies; wheel service equipment; plastic and rubber components

customer_segment.value: B2B: food processors, agriculture, industrial and automotive manufacturers, tire dealers, vehicle service shops, distributors; B2G: government and defense customers for fuel containers and storage products

end_markets.value: food and beverage; agriculture; automotive aftermarket; industrial; building and construction

revenue_model.value: product sales: molded plastic and rubber products, tire service supplies and equipment

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: molds products from plastic resins and rubber, sold to industrial users, OEMs and distributors; distributor: buys and resells tire, wheel and under-vehicle service supplies to dealers and service shops

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Mexico, with some exports

specialization.value: related lines: material handling polymer products and tire service distribution sharing industrial and automotive customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to industrial, food and OEM customers and large accounts; distributors / dealers: distributors and retailers for storage and consumer products; own locations: company-operated distribution branches serving tire dealers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental and workplace safety rules, fuel container emissions standards from EPA and CARB, food-contact material rules

notes: Based on memory; recent portfolio changes (e.g., Lawn and Garden exit, Scepter sale) may not be fully reflected, and the branch network detail is approximate.
